mechanism.base: Water meets water and nothing new is added, only more of the same. Nothing moistens all things like it, the old texts say. Two currents that join learn no new direction: they just run deeper. Depth is the gift and the danger of this pair, since a spring and a flood share one nature and differ in how much there is. The same element alone is its own supply and its own limit.
mechanism.catalyst_turn: When your own Water runs low, the spring thins and every current slows to a trickle, and each effort draws on a source nothing is refilling. Rest first, then decide.
mechanism.friction_turn: With too much Water, the tide rises with no shore to meet, and depth becomes weight: the same thoughts circling and never landing. Pick one task and pour it all there.

function.definition_catalyst: Your Body is the strength the whole of you stands on. Water makes it flow, and your stamina comes and goes in long stretches. Running thin, the well is shallow. Every push takes from what little you hold, and the bottom comes early.
function.definition_friction: Your Body is the strength the whole of you stands on. Water makes it deep, and much stays unseen. Running over, the depth floods inward. Your force and your wants pile up inside, and you carry more than anyone near you ever sees.
function.definition_balanced: Your Body is the strength the whole of you stands on. Water makes it flow, and your stamina comes and goes in long stretches. In balance, the tide goes out and comes back in. You spend and refill in turn, and you never run dry.
function.advise_catalyst: Every push you make draws on a reserve that was small to begin with. Rest a full day after any big push. Ask a friend for the whole answer rather than guessing it. Hand half of one shared task to a peer.
function.advise_friction: Seek Earth, the Order energy. Earth is the bank: it gives moving water a path and a shore. Let it shape what your Water pours. Without a shore your strength either piles up into weight or spills over. Before Sunday, finish one job you have put off. Keep the same day each week for one steady task.
function.advise_balanced: Your stamina holds while every long push is met by an equally long refill. Rest a full day after any big push. Ask a friend for the whole answer rather than guessing it.

candidates.cta_verdict: Your stamina rises and falls in long swings, and you spend the low stretches on your own more often than in company.

catalyst.clause: the spring thins and every current slows to a trickle

friction.clause: the tide rises with no shore to meet
friction.remedy: Pick one task and pour it all there.

unrooted.clause: No spring of your own, so every current you ride is borrowed from somewhere else.
unrooted.remedy: Borrow depth: rest, and keep one steady friend close.

excess.clause: Water piled past its banks goes stale: the depth needs something growing to drain into.
excess.remedy: Drain it into something growing. Build, plant, start.

thin.clause: Little Water of your own, and no loss in that: nothing pools long enough to weigh on you.
thin.remedy: Keep it small and keep it moving.

catalyst.clause: The rain doubts what it felt: perception discounted, knowing deferred to louder instruments.

friction.clause: The mist never lifts: so much felt and so little said that nothing ever gets checked.
friction.remedy: Rain still needs ground to land on.

mechanism_yin.base: Nothing moistens all things like water, the Book of Changes says: depth joined to depth, clouds feeding the rain that returns as cloud. There is no reaction here, only gathering. Still water clarifies, soft rain remembers, and the same softness that yields to every stone eventually wears the stone away.
mechanism_yin.catalyst_turn: Run thin, the rain doubts what it felt: perception discounted, knowing deferred to louder instruments. Your chart asks you to feed the self. Trust one read all the way through.
mechanism_yin.friction_turn: Run heavy, the mist never lifts: so much felt and so little said that nothing ever gets checked. Say the read aloud. Rain still needs ground to land on.

__ore.retired_fn_body: The Core is your endurance function: the seat your strength refills from. With Water doubled here, your vitality is a deep table: quiet reserves that recharge from below, stamina that flows around obstacles rather than breaking on them. You recover in solitude and silence the way aquifers do. Guard the recharge fiercely. A drawn-down well still looks like a well from above.
__ore.retired_base_personal: Your core is Water, and here Water stands with Water: depth alongside depth, one sea fed by its own rivers. This is a reinforcement rather than a reaction, the part of your chart that is simply more of you. That is why Water is your Body: your perception, your patience, your way of knowing what moves beneath. The other energies act on you. This one simply deepens.

backlog_dips_tg_pattern.mind: You read before you reason: currents and motives sensed whole. Surface the working sometimes.
backlog_dips_tg_pattern.action: You move when the tide is right and not before: timing is your entire style of force.

__ore.retired_v3_definition_catalyst:
Water is your Body, and running thin, it is the deep reserve under your perception: sleep quality, quiet time, the stillness your system restores itself in. Yours drains invisibly, through noise and company, long before you feel tired.

Present, attentive, secretly threadbare. The social week was lovely and cost a fortune, sleep is shallow where it used to be bottomless, and the intuition you rely on has started arriving late.

Solitude is your maintenance, so dose it like medicine. One silent hour daily, no inputs. A full day alone each month, calendared in advance. Leave gatherings while they are still good, and let the quiet finish what the rest began.
__ore.retired_v3_definition_friction:
Water is your Body, and running over, it is stillness pooling into stagnation: rest that no longer restores, sleep that stretches without refreshing, energy waiting for a current that never comes.

Calm on the surface, becalmed underneath. The naps multiply, the plans get postponed into next month, and the deep reserves everyone envies sit unspent, going slightly stale while the world assumes you are fine.

Depth stays fresh by moving. Add motion that flows, swimming, walking, cycling, and make one weekly commitment that gets you out the door regardless of mood. Say yes before the mood votes. Stir the water and watch the energy remember itself.
